description.value: Raku Japanese Kitchen is a sushi and Japanese cuisine restaurant situated on Marine Drive in West Vancouver, a route popular with cyclists traveling along the North Shore. The restaurant offers both indoor and outdoor seating, providing a comfortable rest stop. Online ordering is available, suggesting a takeout option for cyclists on the go.
